preferences.name: customLockCmd

preferences.description: Custom command to run for Lock Screen. Leave empty to use default (vicinae://launch/power/lock).

preferences.name: customSuspendCmd

preferences.name: customRebootCmd

preferences.name: customLogoutCmd

preferences.description: Custom command to run for Logout. Leave empty to use default (vicinae://launch/power/logout).
